title: My elevator stopped on floor zero 🛗
style_prompt: photorealistic 35mm film photograph, cold teal fluorescent light, eerie and calm, empty office tower at night, no people, no faces, no text, no numbers, no logos
hook_text: At 12:04 a.m. my elevator stopped on floor zero.

scenes.narration: At 12:04 a.m. my elevator stopped on floor zero.

shots.prompt: open steel elevator doors in an empty office tower at night, dim corridor beyond, teal light

scenes.narration: I run the elevator in an empty office tower. Night shift. Twelve floors. No floor zero.

shots.prompt: empty marble office lobby at night with a steel elevator, dark glass doors

scenes.narration: The panel had no zero button. I had not pressed anything. The doors simply opened.

shots.prompt: close view of an elevator button panel with glowing buttons, one dark empty gap at the bottom

scenes.narration: Beyond the doors, a concrete hallway. Fluorescent lights buzzed. Wet floor. No one.

shots.prompt: inside view of an elevator cabin looking out through open doors at a dim concrete hallway, wet floor, buzzing tube lights

scenes.narration: I pressed the lobby button. Nothing happened. The doors stayed open.

shots.prompt: elevator panel with a pressed glowing button, open doors reflecting teal light

scenes.narration: Then a bell rang. Far down the hallway. Another elevator was arriving.

shots.prompt: steel elevator doors with a glowing floor indicator above them, in a bare concrete room, teal light

scenes.narration: Its doors opened. Empty. A light blinked inside, as if waiting for me.

shots.prompt: steel elevator cabin interior, bright cold light, polished metal walls, empty, seen head-on

scenes.narration: My radio crackled. Dispatch said, you are late for your shift. I said, I am on my shift.

shots.prompt: old handheld radio on a steel desk, small green light, dark concrete room

scenes.narration: Dispatch said, no. Your shift ended yesterday. Come down to zero. We have your chair.

shots.prompt: an empty office chair standing alone in a bare concrete room under one flickering tube light, wet floor

scenes.narration: I walked past a desk. A monitor showed the lobby upstairs. My lobby.

shots.prompt: old crt security monitor glowing in a dark concrete room, screen shows a grainy marble lobby

scenes.narration: On the screen, my chair was empty. The elevator upstairs stood open. Someone inside faced the camera. Wearing my uniform.

shots.prompt: grainy black and white security camera view of a steel elevator cabin with a tall dark silhouette standing inside facing the camera, no face, dark uniform

scenes.narration: Behind me, the doors to zero slid shut. A button lit up. It said, going up.

shots.prompt: elevator doors closing from inside, narrow gap of light, glowing orange button on the panel

scenes.narration: So tell me. Do you stay down here, or ride up?

shots.prompt: open steel elevator doors in an empty office tower at night, dim corridor beyond, teal light
